data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(None directly.) This task provides shared infrastructure (tests/lib/config-isolation.sh) consumed by task-2 and task-3; all story DDs are evidenced by those tasks' ACs. No direct DD ownership. The helper is SHARED with sibling story 0db3 — it MUST be a single implementation; do not fork a second copy.

## Description
Create tests/lib/config-isolation.sh as a sourceable bash helper exposing config_isolation_setup / config_isolation_teardown. setup produces a config-isolated environment: HOME -> fresh mktemp dir (empty HOME), GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null (no global git config), a clean mktemp working directory (no pre-existing worktrees), and DSO_*/GIT_* developer env vars unset within the isolated scope. teardown removes the mktemp dirs. All intermediate dirs via mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/configiso.XXXXXX". chmod +x. Add tests/lib/config-isolation.sh to the plugin-boundary allowlist if tests/lib/ not already covered. Co-create a self-test tests/lib/test-config-isolation.sh.

## TDD Test Approach
Given a dev env with populated HOME + global git config; When config-isolation.sh is sourced and config_isolation_setup invoked and a command runs in the isolated scope; Then HOME points at a fresh empty mktemp dir, `git config --global --list` is empty, no worktree/DSO_* is visible; teardown removes the mktemp dirs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] config-isolation.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/lib/config-isolation.sh
- [ ] Self-test passes
  Verify: bash tests/lib/test-config-isolation.sh
- [ ] Sources cleanly with setup+teardown functions defined
  Verify: bash -c 'source tests/lib/config-isolation.sh && type config_isolation_setup >/dev/null && type config_isolation_teardown >/dev/null'
- [ ] mktemp template used (no hardcoded /tmp literal)
  Verify: grep -Eq 'mktemp[^\n]*\$\{TMPDIR:-/tmp\}/configiso\.XXXXXX' tests/lib/config-isolation.sh
- [ ] tests/lib/config-isolation.sh is covered by the plugin-boundary allowlist
  Verify: grep -Eq 'tests/lib' .claude/hooks/pre-commit/plugin-boundary-allowlist.conf

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Create shared tests/lib/config-isolation.sh helper for config-isolated test env
